segments.title: Multi-Platform Opening & Hype Train Malfunction
segments.notes: Case opens on multiple platforms simultaneously; Hype Train triggers but music fails, completing at level 2 before Case cuts it off; subscription acknowledgments for Dr. Cool, Be Grendel, CV Loves You, Tam Tran, and others.

segments.title: Taco Bell Sex Party Lawsuit & Snoop Dogg Stove Ad
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins to cover former Taco Bell employee Alana Beacham's lawsuit alleging a Christmas party with covered windows/cameras devolved into open sex, vomiting into guacamole bowl, and retaliation; brief Snoop Dogg Solo Stove ad diversion; avocado call-in guest describes trauma of witnessing orgy and being vomited into.

segments.title: Post-Avocado De-Hornying & Macy's Parade Preview
segments.notes: Case attempts to de-horny the stream after avocado interview; announces Thanksgiving Macy's Day parade stream with Kendall tomorrow at 8 AM PT; mentions possible special guest Tim Lamb.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Sonic, Bunhofer, Good Burger 2, Imaginary
segments.notes: Trent (with parole officer Chris) reviews trailers: Sonic Dream Team mobile game, Bunhofer (Dietrich Bonhoeffer biopic mistaken for ass-sniffing film), Good Burger 2 (skip), Imaginary (scary teddy bear horror); Trent interviews haunted bear in green room.

segments.title: Bin Bear Appearance & Greg T U 15-Stream Streak
segments.notes: Bin Bear (sex bear mascot) appears for Greg T U's 15-stream streak achievement; Case clarifies bear is a coworker, not imaginary friend.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon on Hollywood Israel Divisions
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon sneaks onto desk to discuss Hollywood Reporter article on agency divisions over Israel-Gaza: WME/CAA personnel moves, Melissa Barrera firing, Susan Sarandon dropped, Tom Cruise backing Maha Dakhil, genocide terminology debates; Peter retreats when conversation gets too heavy.

segments.title: Turkey vs Bald Eagle National Bird Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues for bald eagle (raw masculinity, patriotism, 'gain six inches of raw dick'); Crum argues for turkey (consumption culture, family values, pack aggression, owed respect for 200 years of eating them); Munch claims 20-point lead in debate score, threatens defection to 'Munchtopia' if turkey wins.

segments.title: Turkinheimer PSA & Thanksgiving Freestyle
segments.notes: DJ Newsic covers Consumer Product Safety Commission's musical turkey-frying PSA 'Turkinheimer'; improvises auto-tuned song about deep-fried turkey deaths and turkey pride; ends stream with roll call and raid to Bruce Greene.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors multi-platform broadcast; manages Hype Train malfunction; covers Taco Bell lawsuit, Hollywood Israel story, and furniture shopping plans.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: senior news mouth. Delivers Taco Bell sex party lawsuit coverage; issues retraction on vomiting timeline; interviews traumatized avocado; debuts new catchphrase attempt.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Triggers at level 2 with broken music; delivers anti-serotonin manifesto before Case cuts feed; completes and goes to sleep.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: movie correspondent. Hosts Trent at the Movies from personal theater; reviews trailers under community service sentence; interviews haunted bear in green room.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: parole officer. Supervises Trent's community service; provides gameplay footage for Sonic Dream Team; discusses youth camp bear safety protocols.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Sneaks onto desk to discuss Hollywood Israel divisions; retreats when conversation gets too heavy; mentions leaving coffee mug as excuse.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues for bald eagle as national bird; claims 20-point debate lead over Crum; threatens mass defection to Munchtopia if turkey wins.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues for turkey as national bird citing consumption culture and pack aggression; trails Munch by 20 points in debate score.

characters.name: Avocado
characters.notes: call-in guest. Describes trauma of witnessing Taco Bell orgy and being vomited into; complains of rotting and requests mashing within 24 hours.

characters.name: Bear
characters.notes: interview subject. Haunted teddy bear in green room; evades Trent's questions with cryptic acting advice; causes Trent to flee in terror.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a multi-platform broadcast covering a Taco Bell Christmas party lawsuit involving open sex and guacamole contamination, then transitions to Trent at the Movies reviewing trailers including a haunted bear interview. Peter Gibbon sneaks onto the desk to discuss Hollywood agency divisions over Israel-Gaza before retreating. Munch and Crum debate turkey versus bald eagle as national bird, with Munch claiming a 20-point lead. DJ Newsic closes with a musical take on the CPSC's 'Turkinheimer' turkey-frying safety PSA and raids Bruce Greene.
